designSystem.visualDirection: modern, premium, natural-light realistic workplace photography, restrained colour, adult-learner appropriate

screens.title: Listen & Match the Jobs
screens.layout: 7 numbered natural-photo job cards with compact answer field directly below each card
screens.mediaRule: replace oversized or mismatched imagery with distinct realistic workplace scenes that correspond to the seven audio speakers
screens.studentAction: listen and type/match in the box below each numbered picture
screens.teacherAction: inspect Responses first, then reveal the answer inside the same corresponding box
screens.fit: all active items must fit desktop presentation without scrolling

screens.title: Name the Jobs
screens.layout: new visual arrangement; do not simply repeat Screen 3 as a static copy
screens.studentAction: type the occupation under each visual cue
screens.teacherAction: Show answer reveals correct occupation in each field
screens.interactionUpgrade: use visual detail crops / workplace clue panels so recognition is not identical to Screen 3

screens.title: What Are They Doing?

items: The shop assistant is tidying some clothes.
The flight attendant is bringing the pilots some food.
The salesman is working at his computer.
The mechanic is having a break.
The website designer is plugging in her computer.
The hairdresser is holding a mirror.
The engineer is looking at a plan.

screens.layout: Part 1 shows 4 numbered pictures + 4 boxes on one screen; Part 2 shows 3 numbered pictures + 3 boxes on one screen
screens.studentAction: type one sentence directly under each picture
screens.teacherAction: Show answer fills each corresponding box in place
screens.rule: Part 1 and Part 2 must never duplicate the same items

screens.title: Would You Like This Job?
screens.visualAid: one elegant decision board with three large selectable job cards and concise reason prompts
screens.studentAction: choose one job and give one reason
screens.teacherAction: collect Responses and optionally reveal model language, not a single fixed opinion
modelFrames: I'd like to be a ... because ...
I wouldn't like to be a ... because ...

screens.title: Who Works Here? · Clue Challenge
screens.prompt: Study the scene. Use two visual clues to infer a person's job and justify your choice.
screens.studentAction: select a person, type the job, then type one short clue-based justification
screens.teacherAction: review Response Board, discuss alternative predictions, reveal likely/source-supported jobs only after discussion

screens.title: Listen for Gist
screens.layout: audio waveform + two very large answer fields; no oversized repeated picture wall
answers: He is a security officer in a shopping mall.
He is talking to a police officer.
screens.teacherAction: Responses first, then Show answer in the same two fields

screens.title: Listen for Detail
screens.layout: fresh five-person mall evidence strip; smaller visual tiles and numbered response boxes
screens.partPolicy: if split is needed, use 3 items in Part 1 and 2 items in Part 2; never repeat an item
screens.studentAction: listen and enter the five job names
screens.teacherAction: check Response Board before in-place reveal

screens.title: Present Simple or Present Continuous?
screens.layout: text-first, one sentence card at a time with large type and one answer field
screens.pacing: teacher advances item-by-item; cumulative reveal may remain visible after each reveal
screens.studentAction: complete the current sentence and optionally choose USUAL or NOW as reason
screens.teacherAction: inspect Responses, Check, then Show answer for the current sentence

media.rule: media should resolve through the shared platform media layer; avoid redundant repository payload
media.visualSetNotes: natural contemporary workplaces, no cartoon aesthetic, no repeated generic stock set, each picture numbered where used for response

qualityGate: student answer fields in task context
